questions.stem: What is the primary role of a wholesaler in the distribution channel?

options.text: To sell goods directly to consumers.
To buy goods in bulk from producers and sell to retailers.
To transport goods from one location to another.

questions.explanation: Wholesalers purchase goods in large quantities from producers and sell them in smaller quantities to retailers. This helps in the efficient distribution of goods.

distractorRationale.b: Retailers, not wholesalers, sell directly to consumers.
